entities.name: Graddock
entities.description: An elf hermit in Yavimaya who bonds with forest animals and warned humans away.

entities.name: Kylor
entities.description: An elven scout who killed the human mage leading the camp.

entities.name: Delva
entities.description: An elven archer captured with Graddock.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion shortly after which Graddock lived in Yavimaya.

entities.name: Yavimaya's protector
entities.description: The incredible power the humans were left to face.

events.summary: Graddock tried to convince encroaching humans to leave Yavimaya.
events.quote: Graddock attempted to convince them to leave by making them aware of the incredible danger of settling in Yavimaya

events.summary: The humans knocked out Graddock and imprisoned him with Kylor and Delva.
events.quote: the humans knocked Graddock out, captured the three elves, and imprisoned them in a tent

events.summary: Graddock summoned squirrels to gnaw through bonds and tent ropes, causing chaos; Kylor killed the human mage and the elves retreated.
events.quote: Kylor killed the human mage leading the camp, and the three elves retreated to Yavimaya.
